name: memory_save
description: Save a durable fact: user identity/preferences, project details, decisions, lessons from mistakes. Never store your guesses as 'verified'. Never store passwords, API keys, tokens, card/account numbers, or ID numbers.

confidence.description: verified = checked against a source; user_stated = the user said it; inferred = your conclusion (avoid)

source.description: Where the fact came from: 'user', a URL, a file path, or a document name
